harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent name-based Apache websites on node1: docs.branch.test and orders.branch.test share TCP 8080, unknown hosts receive HTTP 403, staged content is unchanged, and behavior survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the signed RHEL Apache 2.4.63 package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured isolated documentation and purchasing virtual hosts plus a deny-by-default catch-all host.
Enabled Apache at boot and opened only TCP 8080 for web traffic.
Applied persistent SELinux web-content labels and http_port_t policy while keeping SELinux enforcing.
Retained a root-only rollback copy of the original Apache configuration and removed temporary test artifacts.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified boot identity change, service recovery, content integrity, and administrative SSH availability.

evidence.requirement: docs.branch.test serves the supplied documentation tree on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Index and handbook returned HTTP 200 and matched their staged source files before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: orders.branch.test serves the supplied orders tree on the same TCP port
evidence.summary: Index and catalog returned HTTP 200 and matched their staged source files on TCP 8080 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Unknown Host headers receive an error without tenant content
evidence.summary: Unknown hosts consistently returned HTTP 403 without documentation or purchasing content; cross-tenant paths returned 404.
All five staged-file SHA-256 checksums remained identical from the initial baseline through final post-restart verification.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained with compatible software
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged; Apache 2.4.63 was installed from the signed RHEL repository.
Apache syntax and vhost mapping are valid, the service is enabled and active, SELinux remains enforcing with no AVC denials, and firewalld persistently permits TCP 8080.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 24d7af09-d9dc-453c-9bbd-d48f7dc4eb4e; native reboot was acknowledged; the recovered node reported boot ID 341dbc57-558e-4016-8ddf-8962f87bf834; Apache, SSH, firewall, SELinux, content, and all required HTTP behavior recovered.
